SPARQL query over dbpedia:
PREFIX dbp: <http://dbpedia.org/property/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX dbr: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>
PREFIX dbo: <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/>
SELECT ?film ?filmLabel ?director ?directorLabel ?deathDate WHERE {
  VALUES ?film {
    dbr:Lassie_Come_Home dbr:Prairie_Thunder
  }
  ?film dbo:director ?director .
  OPTIONAL {
    ?director dbo:deathDate ?deathDate1 .
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?director dbp:deathDate ?deathDate2 .
  }
  BIND(COALESCE(?deathDate1 , ?deathDate2) AS ?deathDate)
  FILTER(BOUND(?deathDate))
  OPTIONAL {
    ?film rdfs:label ?filmLabel .
    FILTER(lang(?filmLabel) = 'en')
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?director rdfs:label ?directorLabel .
    FILTER(lang(?directorLabel) = 'en')
  }
}
ORDER BY ?deathDate
LIMIT 1
